lines.title: THE BLOCH SPHERE
lines.text: This sphere shows the state of one qubit, the quantum version of a bit. The glowing arrow is its state. Straight up is |0⟩, straight down is |1⟩.

lines.title: A GATE IS A TURN
lines.text: Every change to a qubit is a turn of the arrow about an axis. The X gate is a half turn about the x axis. Next, you make it yourself: X takes |0⟩ to |1⟩.

lines.title: SUPERPOSITION
lines.text: X flipped the qubit, like an ordinary bit. The H gate is a half turn about a tilted axis, between x and z. Next, H takes the arrow from |1⟩ down onto the equator.

lines.title: MEASUREMENT
lines.text: On the equator the qubit is in a superposition: a measurement gives zero or one by chance. Next, this state is prepared and measured one hundred times.

lines.title: YOUR TURN
lines.text: About half zeros and half ones. Now explore: apply gates, grab the arrow to turn it anywhere, and measure. Press Done when you are finished.
